descriptionHtml:
Candidate N28 · proposed P2 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Nursing Home Save Note never fills Diagnostic Testing: an extracted X-ray stays 'No studies recorded yet.'

Tickets: TFA-92588 AC 1 (Q5) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S02 Nursing Home: the same flow on a resident, including the two-box editor

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The Pre-Round tab has two boxes: the dictation (most of the screen) and Important Points (TC-12). (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 How it works 1; TFA-92590 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals … (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 1; TFA-92588 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U3 Dictated and typed input both save reliably and both produce a usable summary; Save Note reliably commits the note. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 3; TFA-92588 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U5 A bare Celsius temperature stays in °C (PR #48); no unit is guessed for an ambiguous value. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 6; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T3 Save Note never adds, edits or removes an Important Point; points added with '+ Add Point' stay separate cards, stored exactly as typed, in both modes. (TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 AC 3; TFA-92590 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given The make-session Nursing Home resident (diagnosis Post-acute rehab after hip fracture, nothing else on file)

When Open the pre-round editor, type the summary below, look at the editor, press Save Note, then look at the Pre-Round panels

Then The editor holds the dictation box and the Important Points box (editor-only text); after Save the Admission Summary and Vitals, Labs, Medications and Diagnostic Testing hold the dictated values and none shows its empty state; the overnight confusion appears; 37.2 is not shown in °F; Save Note added no Important Point; no error

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs per checkpoint. cp1 uses text that exists only in the Nursing Home editor ('Important points (manual)', 'Kept exactly as you say it'), because the editor is a fixed inset-0 div and the tab's Important Points panel stays in the snapshot; fullscreen is judged in S23 (bounding box). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
